svg.title: C17-M04-F3: Lab exception register results
svg.desc: Three exceptions with their check results: one procedurally valid but high risk, one failing three checks, and one lacking approval.
svg.text: EX-01 terminal server valid on paper -> high-scrutiny path (MFA gap)
EX-02 label printers EXPIRED + no compensating + low approver
EX-03 archive NAS no approver -> not an exception, non-compliance
Figure C17-M04-F3. Execution-tested register check results and their interpretation.
